query.name: stat-project-build-status
query.comment: Project build status for a dashboard
query.sql: SELECT build.status, count(build.id) FROM porion_build_config AS config LEFT JOIN porion_last_build AS build on build.build_config_id = config.id GROUP BY build.status

query.name: command-build-list
query.sql: SELECT project.name AS name, branch.name AS branch_name, config.name AS config_name, build.id AS build_id, build.number AS number, build.tag AS tag, build.status AS build_Status, build.create_date AS build_date, build.finish_date AS finish_date, build.pass_count AS pass_count, build.fail_count AS fail_count FROM porion_build AS build INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON build.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON branch.id = build.branch_id INNER JOIN porion_build_config AS config ON build.build_config_id = config.id ORDER BY finish_date DESC
query.sql-count: SELECT count(build.id) FROM porion_build AS build
